descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S23 Handoff on phone width (Pixel 7 Chromium, iPhone 15 WebKit)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Each patient's handoff has four sections: active issues, discharge barriers, pending results, to-do/if-then. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U4 The sending physician can edit the generated handoff before sending, and the recipient, retrieving it from their own account, sees exactly the edited text. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U9 A 'Copy' button copies the current handoff text, including any edits, to the clipboard, the same as 'Copy to EMR' on the note; copying stays on the device and nothing is emailed or shared. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Visual lane profiles pixel7 and iphone15

When Open both sheets and the Send dialog with a long handoff in the editor

Then Section headings and items are not truncated or covered; the editor, recipient list, Copy and Send fit and can be reached; the dialog does not overflow

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): visual-lane findings covered/overflow/truncated/tap = 0 on these screens; findings go to a human (vision-review.sh)

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-08.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
